load_failed: Failed to load the command queue
title: Commands
queue_hint: Delivered on the device's next heartbeat poll.
revocations_title: Revocations not yet confirmed at the door
revocations_warning: The person named below can still open this door until the device confirms it collected this. If the device is offline it waits.
cancel_keeps_access: Cancel — Pin {{pin}} keeps access to this door
cancel_leftover: Cancel the leftover delete — door permission record only
outstanding_hint: Pending means the device has not polled yet — normal for an offline terminal, not a failure. Sent means delivered and awaiting confirmation, retrying on backoff.
nothing_outstanding: Nothing outstanding. This device owes nothing right now.
pending_line: waiting for the device to poll · queued {{queued}}
cancel_sent_warning: Already sent to the device at least once — cancelling only removes our record, it does not recall it.
history_hint: What actually happened, read from the outcome — not from the queue being empty.
retry_refused_warning: The device refused this with Return={{code}} — unless something changed at the device it will very likely refuse again, unchanged.
retry_unconfirmed_warning: The device answered Return={{code}} last time, which this system cannot read as either success or refusal — so this command may already have worked. Sending it again is safe, but it is not a retry of a known failure.
